info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Direct Debit Cancellations API
info.description: The Direct Debit Cancellations API enables businesses to efficiently manage and process requests for cancelling direct debit transactions. This API provides functionalities for initiating cancellation requests, ensuring that users can halt any pending or active direct debits with ease. Typical consumers include financial institutions, payment service providers, and banking applications that require transaction management capabilities. Users can leverage this API to maintain accurate financial records and enhance customer service by promptly handling cancellation requests.

post.summary: Initiates a cancellation request for the specified direct debit.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to initiate a cancellation request for a direct debit identified by its resource ID. Ensure that you provide all necessary details in the request body to successfully process the cancellation.
